## Exact frozen precedence

1. Contract defect => EXPERIMENTAL_CONTRACT_DEFECT
2. RI/view/provenance/personalization/PPR/fusion implementation defect => GRAPH_RANKING_DEFECT
3. REQUIRED resource/cell/unit reach loss OR baseline completion loss OR any unbounded required rank/selected depth regression => GRAPH_HARMFUL
4. Valid and no loss/unbounded regression, graph-contributed meaningful witness gain or REQUIRED reach rescue AND (strong burden improvement OR safe material reach gain) => GRAPH_HYBRID_SUPPORTED
5. No loss/unbounded regression, graph-contributed meaningful rank/witness gain or novel REQUIRED reach rescue => COMPLEMENTARY_GRAPH_VALUE
6. Otherwise => NO_MATERIAL_VALUE

This isolates deterministic ranking/fusion consequences within Case 0016's sealed frame and fixed treatments, conditional on the sole blind primary gold. It establishes no production benefit, universal retrieval superiority, agent success or search-policy failure. B uses A-derived seeds, so agreement is not independent evidence. Direct self/cross shares are post-gold diagnostics; no counterfactual edge removal or prospective treatment rerun occurred.
